## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Variable name must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive) | validation | !namePattern.MatchString(name) |
| Variable name must not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix | validation | forbiddenPrefixPattern.MatchString(name) |
| Variable name must not be 'CI' (reserved) | validation | strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Variable data must not exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes on insert/update | business_logic | Always applied |
| Variable name is stored uppercase | business_logic | Always applied on insert and update |
| Creating a variable that already exists returns 409 Conflict | business_logic | v != nil && v.ID > 0 |
